goal: Open Fixed Assets / FA-CNC-01 context read-only and inventory non-executing action areas to find Calculate Depreciation without clicking it.

unlockedBy.decision: Journal route did not expose Calculate Depreciation; local action map points to Fixed Assets context.

acceptanceCriteria: Business Central stays in MCP_1_20260210 / RM-DEMO.
Fixed Assets or existing FA-CNC-01 context is visible read-only.
Only non-executing dropdowns/tabs such as More Options, Process/Actions, Related or Page are opened if safe.
Visible action candidates are inventoried and classified.
No executing action or menu item is clicked.
If Calculate Depreciation is found, only a later local decision case may unlock any execution.
stopConditions: Business Central shows a different instance or company.
FA-CNC-01 context is not visible when required.
A locator points to an executing action instead of a dropdown/tab.
Any confirmation or modal dialog appears.
An action must be clicked to reveal the next level.
nextSafeAction: Run one read-only Fixed Assets action inventory; do not click Calculate Depreciation, Post Acquisition Cost, Preview Posting, Post, New, Edit or Delete.
